description: The Laya decision family (H5): decision_choose (a choice over the caller's options), decision_test (yes/no) and decision_score (an ordinal level) over the pinned multilingual Laya checkpoint (github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya, commit c73908d96ff73c0062c340a11bf7c54ec7d8bc4d, tag v0.4.6, Apache-2.0), running through the vendored laya-ts runtime. Every returned confidence is EXPLICITLY UNCALIBRATED (DEC-08): the upstream model card ships uncalibrated logits and a clamping warning, and this extension never presents them as calibrated probabilities.

tools.name: decision_choose_local
tools.description: Choose one of the caller's options for a stated prompt, over the pinned Laya checkpoint, using the extension-local result shape (label + per-option probabilities). Bounded by 512 state tokens and a 192-token head budget; up to 16 options. Requests that drop state tokens or collapse distinct options are rejected (INPUT_TRUNCATED / INDISTINGUISHABLE_OPTIONS, DEC-05). Returns the chosen option, the per-option scores, and a confidence that is EXPLICITLY UNCALIBRATED (DEC-08) — the upstream model ships uncalibrated logits.

tools.name: decision_choose
tools.description: Standard decision.choose: choose one of 2–16 options for a stated decision and return the chosen option as an INDEX plus a confidence bucket and reason. The runtime's chosen label is revalidated against the caller's FULL option set; an unknown label refuses. Confidence is a bucket over the EXPLICITLY UNCALIBRATED probability mass (DEC-08).

tools.name: decision_test
tools.description: Answer a stated yes/no question over the pinned Laya checkpoint. Bounded by 512 state tokens and a 192-token head budget; truncated state or collapsed options are rejected (INPUT_TRUNCATED / INDISTINGUISHABLE_OPTIONS, DEC-05). The confidence is EXPLICITLY UNCALIBRATED (DEC-08).

tools.name: decision_score
tools.description: Score a stated prompt onto one of the caller's ordinal levels over the pinned Laya checkpoint. Bounded by 512 state tokens and a 192-token head budget, with up to 16 levels/options; truncated state or collapsed levels are rejected (INPUT_TRUNCATED / INDISTINGUISHABLE_OPTIONS, DEC-05). The confidence is EXPLICITLY UNCALIBRATED (DEC-08).

tools.name: decision_test_typed
tools.description: Evaluate a yes/no proposition against a state over the SAME pinned Laya checkpoint and head as decision_test, returning the native P(proposition) explicitly as an UNCALIBRATED model_probability (DEC-06, DEC-08). Bounded by a 32768-character state and a 4096-character proposition; requests that exceed the prepared head's token budget or collapse options are rejected (INPUT_TRUNCATED / INDISTINGUISHABLE_OPTIONS, DEC-05). The boolean answer applies a disclosed reviewed threshold over probabilityTrue; it is not ground truth.

tools.name: decision_score_typed
tools.description: Score a state/question onto 2–32 ordered levels over the SAME pinned Laya checkpoint and head as decision_score, preserving the native ORDINAL distribution and its FRACTIONAL expected index (Σ i·p_i, never converted to a hard label), with UNCALIBRATED model_probability values (DEC-06, DEC-08). Level ids and descriptions must be unique; truncated state or collapsed levels are rejected (INPUT_TRUNCATED / INDISTINGUISHABLE_OPTIONS, DEC-05).

skills.name: decision-decomposition
skills.description: Decompose a decision into code-computed facts and atomic Laya/Jev judgments, then combine them with an explicit trace instead of one giant choice question.

telemetryContent: the vendored runtime performs no network access; the pinned artifacts load from the host-prepared local directory only
